announcements.headline: Grant of Options and Director Dealing
announcements.insight: Routine administrative disclosure of option grants and director dealings typical for Molecule Group's biotech model; lacks the transformative catalysts required to move the stock price in a sector already sensitive to clinical trial outcomes rather than internal governance events.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Transaction
announcements.insight: Standard disclosure of individual director transactions which typically carries negligible signal for institutional investors compared to aggregate insider net buying/selling trends.
